answer: The crystal schedule is applied in harbor and voyage shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 38% arrives at settlement and the rest over 4 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Someone thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 895 identities would post 4754 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
